preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string s is one of 'A', 'B', or 'C'.
The length of the string s is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (count_A == count_C or (count_A - count_C) % 2 == 0 and count_B >= abs(count_A - count_C)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if the string can be fully erased by a sequence of valid actions. This happens when either the counts of 'A' and 'C' are equal, or the difference between counts of 'A' and 'C' is even and the count of 'B' is at least the absolute difference between counts of 'A' and 'C'.
